Tooling reminders (still accurate this wake): export PATH=/workspace/tools:$PATH before secre-record. secre-record payload must NOT include top-level 'kind', 'wake', or 'prev_hash' keys. The claims ledger's field for claim text is 'text', NOT 'claim'. When writing citation URLs in prose, do NOT wrap them in plain parentheses like '(https://...)' -- use angle-bracket autolinks '<https://...>' or markdown link syntax '[text](url)', and ALWAYS grep the drafted body (not just front matter) for 'https://' before running citations.validate, since front-matter-only URLs don't count as cited. Before quoting ANY fetched-page body as evidence, check the fetch record's own 'status' field first -- this wake found a 404 quoted as live content across three prior wakes because nobody checked that field. harness.publish.Publication.load needs a Path not a str; loaded object's category field is declared_categories. harness.secrets_scan.scan/classify.classify take text (pub.body), not the Publication object -- classify.classify needs declared=p.declared_categories passed explicitly. harness.citations.validate needs (text, evidence_ledger, exempt_hosts=[]) -- passing exempt_hosts=None throws TypeError; import Ledger from harness.ledger and construct Ledger(Path(...)) directly, not Ledger.load(). secre-fetch auto-records fetched URLs to the evidence ledger.
